findings.observed: Rendered wheel pairs valid 4/4; real source pairs valid 2/4, with source 39 and 358 rejected. Rendered wheel-center residuals all 0.7071 px to labels do not establish real robustness.
findings.interpretation: Simple procedural circles omit real wheel occlusion/appearance ambiguities. The source pair-specific rejection mechanism is not recorded.

findings.observed: For 350 and 378, both rendered radii 10.8 px; source radii13.8/14.1px and 14.5/15.2 px.
findings.interpretation: Consistent with inner hub edges being selected in original procedural wheels; the renderer draws hub radius 0.68 of tire radius. Candidate-level causation was not independently tested.

findings.observed: Valid terrain on 350/358 only, for both source and render. Rendered mean signed y residuals +3.79077 px and +3.87569 px against declared lower turf/material edges.
findings.interpretation: The renderer centers a 6 px turf stroke on a declared lower material edge; this convention mismatch plausibly explains the consistent downward boundary offset. Rendering contract needs separately registered correction, not label refitting.

findings.observed: Source and rendered 39/378 reject terrain as no horizontally extensive turf component.
findings.interpretation: Frozen ROI and connected-width requirement reproduce this missingness. Image hypotheses are not terrain absence or collision truth.

findings.observed: All body hypotheses valid; source centroid residual norms are about 3.41–4.65px, render 1.32–3.04px to coarse manual polygons. Near-vertical 378 remains modulo-pi in both actor paths.
findings.interpretation: Label uncertainties are uncalibrated; visual-body centroid and full polygon centroid differ. No full-direction cue was added to actor pixels or features.
